impact: 294 mm of rain during the passage, gust of 91 knots, pressure 983 mb

impact: Three houses flattened, nineteen members of one family displaced
description: Reader report on Barbados Underground: a Wildey residence where three houses were flattened, affecting nineteen family members. Single unverified source.

impact: About 1,000 houses damaged (estimates to 1,500), 200 to be replaced, power out for 75 to 80 percent, no deaths
description: Roofs, trees and power lines down island wide; the Department of Emergency Management had logged 352 house damage reports by 14:00 on 31 October and about 1,000 damaged houses were confirmed by mid November, with estimates of 1,400 to 1,500 and 200 to be replaced (the NHC report gives about 1,200). Barbados Light and Power lost 75 to 80 percent of its service, which reduced the water supply in several areas; 91 blocked roads had been cleared by 31 October; shelters opened in schools and churches; no casualties. Repair bill projected at BBD 37 million; CCRIF payout USD 8.5 million. Compendium: houses, hospitals, schools, water supply, power lines, roads, trees and cars impacted, 501 to 1,000 houses damaged, GPM IMERG country accumulation about 400 mm.
source_1: NHC Tropical Cyclone Report, Hurricane Tomas (AL212010)
